greeting: Ataniup atianik, Ataataup, Irniup, Anirniup Ilangaijup. Quviasukpunga ilissik kativallutik uumani ullaakkut, Ataniup uqausinga tusarlugu.
penitential: Ataniq, nalligijavut. Kristusi, nalligijavut. Ataniq, nalligijavut.
homily: Pivalliajut inuusiup iluani, qanuq inuusiq asanniniqarpalaurmat. Qiviartariaqarpugut silami, qanuq inuusiq takujariaqarpugut. Paulusa titiraqtuq Philippians-kunnut, uqaqtuq: 'Our citizenship is in heaven, and from it we also await a savior, the Lord Jesus Christ.' Taanna uqausiq, 'citizenship is in heaven,' qanuippa? Taanna uqausiq takujariaqarpugut inuusiup iluani, qanuq Benjamin asanniniqarpalaurmat. Benjamin, taanna qaujimajavut, taanna qaujimajavut tallimat pivalliajut, nuannaartuq, qajangnartuq, pinniqtuq. Taanna nalligivikluq, nalligikpatiklu qitiqquqsimajuq. Ilisimaliqput inuusiup iluani, qanuq Benjamin asanniniqarpalaurmat, qanuq ataniq asannininga kikkutuinnarnut tunijaupalaurmat. Taimanna atautikkut, qaujimajavut qanugitilluta. Benjamin, taanna 'con chim airlines'-mik uqalaurmat, quviasulluni. Taanna qajuqtuq inuusiup iluani, ataniup asannininga ilisimallugu. Ilisimaliqput taanna asanniniq, kikkut nalligijavut aniguqtilaaqtut. Alan and Thao, I know the weight of these past four months. I know the way the world can seem to lose its color when you are carrying such a heavy cross. But look at the Gospel, look at the steward who understands the true value of what he has been given. God is searching for you, He is holding you, and Benjamin is there, resting in the light, smiling that gentle, brilliant smile. He is not lost; he is found in the heart of the Father. Ryan, my dear brother, your brother Ben loved you. He was your partner. When you look at the sky, when you see a plane soaring high, remember that Ben's spirit is soaring too. He is free, he is full of light, and he is watching over you with a bright, gentle smile. Kikkut ilissik uqumaittumik atuqtut, kikkut uqalurialiqtut iluani, nalligivikluq ataniq qaninganiittuq. Ilisimajariaqarpugut ataniq qaninganiittuq. Ilissik ilisimajariaqarpugut asanniniq aniguqtilaaqtuq. standing_petitions: Benjamin Vo-mik qinujuq, kikkut aniguqtilaaqtut, Ataniup qaujimajanga.
spiritual_communion: Jesusi, ilisimaliqpunga ilvittik qaninganiittutit. Asagivikpunga. Uummatimniittutit, qaitillugu asanniniq.

readings.label: Reading 1
readings.text: Ilagiik, imitator-nguilaursi uannik, qatanngutikka, qaujimajavut qanuq inuusiq. Kikkut inuusiq asanniniqarpalaurmat. Niriungnanga ataniup. Citizenship is in heaven. Benjamin, taanna qaujimajavut.

readings.label: Gospel
readings.text: Jesus uqaqtuq, 'A rich man had a steward who was reported to him for squandering his property.' Benjamin, taanna qaujimajavut.

day: Friday of the Thirty-first Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!
